name: MF2R-03 automatic candidate without source rejects
clause: An automatic candidate without a source is refused.
whyDirect: The production candidate repository receives agent-derived content with an empty source list and the test asserts SOURCE_REQUIRED; the same test separately permits user-explicit content.

name: MF2R-03 automatic candidate without source rejects
clause: The source gate does not misclassify an explicitly user-authored save.
whyDirect: The production repository result is read back after the explicit-user exception, proving the automatic-source rule is scoped to automatic content.

name: MF2R-09 conflict open and resolve
clause: An opened conflict can be explicitly resolved.
whyDirect: The repository opens a persisted conflict and the production resolution path returns its resolved status.

name: MF2R-21 keep-both releases both conflicted entries
clause: Explicit keep-both resolution preserves both sides.
whyDirect: The production conflict resolver records the selected disposition and the test reads that durable decision.

name: MF2R-23 reject-both rejects both sides
clause: Explicit reject-both resolution applies the recorded effects to both entries.
whyDirect: The production resolver returns both persisted status transitions and the assertion checks the complete effect list.

name: MF2R-04 review-required triggers
clause: A candidate marked for Scope promotion enters review-required rather than automatic acceptance.
whyDirect: The production promotion gate is exercised with its explicit scopePromotion flag and the returned decision is asserted for the named promotion case.

name: MF2R-16 merge rejects scope or owner leakage
clause: A cross-Scope merge is rejected without mutating the target Entry.
whyDirect: The production review/merge path receives a workspace-scoped candidate for a task-scoped Entry and the test asserts the fail-closed rejection.
